adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `blacklistedGuestEmails` are lowercased, but `uniqueGuests` filtering compares `guest` without normalizing case: `!blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)` and duplicates are checked via `guest === attendee.email`. Since the schema only validates `.email()` (no lowercasing), inputs like `User@example.com` can bypass blacklist entries like `user@example.com` and can also bypass duplicate detection against an existing attendee email with different casing, leading to unintended attendee creation.
